class.name: FoxHoldableItem
class.brief_description: An item that can be held by a FoxCharacter. Utilizes IK targets and poles to hold the item. When setting up, keep at 0,0,0.

members.member: The main hand that will be used for IK.
The off hand that will be used for IK. Leave blank for a one handed item.
The "pole" used for the elbow IK. In other words, where the elbow will be magnetized to. This is to prevent animation errors and give more control of the IK animation.

The "pole" used for the elbow IK. In other words, where the elbow will be magnetized to. This is to prevent animation errors and give more control of the IK animation. Leave blank for a one handed item.
